entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number?

Thank you. I see the order for the Pro-Level Cycling Shoes, delivered 21 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's a fit issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. They just aren't working for me.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing you discomfort. Getting blisters is definitely no fun. Let me just pull up our policy. One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I see here that your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. So, yes, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I did have a bad experience and have to go through the trouble of packaging these up and sending them back, would it be possible to get a 15% discount code for a future purchase? I'd like to try a different model.

I understand your position, but unfortunately, my system doesn't allow for discount codes on top of a full refund. The good news is we can get that refund process started immediately. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just box up the cycling shoes and drop them off at any post office.
Alright, that's fair. A full refund is the main thing. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all. Have a good one.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
